home.title: Overview
home.empty: Active users, purchases, renewals and revenue will appear here.

step_up.title: Verify it's you
step_up.description: This action requires two-factor verification. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Other sensitive actions within 5 minutes won't ask again.

sensitive.reason_hint: Required, up to 500 characters. Recorded in the audit log.

staff.title: Staff
staff.invite_description: The invitee receives an email with a link valid for 72 hours and must set up an authenticator on first sign-in.
staff.sessions_revoked_warning: After the change, all of this staff member's sessions are revoked and they must sign in again.
staff.remove_description: {{email}} will lose access to the console and their sessions end immediately. At least one superadmin must remain.

invitations.revoke_description: The invitation link sent to {{email}} stops working immediately.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: Built-in roles can't be changed or deleted. Custom roles can only use permissions from the catalog; staff and roles are managed by superadmins only.
roles.name: Name
roles.name_hint: Starts with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; 2–32 characters. Can't be changed later.
roles.name_format: Invalid: start with a lowercase letter, 2–32 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only
roles.form_description: Choose the permissions this role grants.
roles.edit_impact_one: Affects {{count}} staff member; their sessions will be revoked.
roles.edit_impact_other: Affects {{count}} staff members; their sessions will be revoked.
roles.delete_description_one: {{count}} staff member currently has this role.
roles.delete_description_other: {{count}} staff members currently have this role.

permissions.content_all: Announcements, help articles and notification templates

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every administrative change is recorded here. Records can't be modified.

accept.title: Accept staff invitation
accept.intro: Accepting adds you to the console. You'll set up an authenticator on first sign-in.
accept.password_hint: If you already have an account, leave this empty and sign in with your existing password. New accounts need a password of at least {{min}} characters.
accept.password_required: There's no account for this email yet. Set a password.
accept.done: You've joined the console. Sign in; you'll set up an authenticator on first sign-in.
accept.missing_token: The invitation link is incomplete. Open it again from the invitation email.
accept.invalid_token: The invitation link is invalid. Ask an administrator to invite you again.
accept.expired: The invitation link has expired. Ask an administrator to invite you again.
accept.invalid_state: This invitation can't be accepted: the account is suspended or is already a staff member.

plans.title: Plans & prices
plans.intro: Changing a plan does not affect existing users' entitlement snapshots; location group access follows the plan in real time. New plans start as drafts and can go on sale once they have a price.
plans.create_description: New plans start as drafts. Add prices and location groups on the plan page after creating it.
plans.name: Name
plans.kind_hint: The type can only change while the plan has no prices and no entitlements.
plans.kind_locked: The plan has prices or entitlements; its type cannot change.
plans.tier_hint: 0 for free plans, greater than 0 otherwise; used for upgrades, downgrades and location group minimum tiers.
plans.status_hint: Drafts are only visible here; on sale plans can be bought; hidden plans are not listed but can be renewed; archived plans can be renewed only if allowed.
plans.bytes_hint: 0 means unlimited. Units are binary (1 GiB = 1024 MiB).
plans.legacy_renew: Allow renewals at the locked price after archiving
plans.legacy_renew_hint: Only applies while the plan is archived.

status_effects.draft: As a draft, users cannot buy or renew it.
status_effects.on_sale: Once on sale, users can buy, renew and switch to this plan.
status_effects.hidden: Hidden plans are not listed; current holders can still renew.
status_effects.archived: Archived plans cannot be bought; renewals depend on the locked-price renewal setting.

validation.tier_kind: Free plans must have tier 0; other plans must have a tier greater than 0

tier.out_of_range: Free plans must have tier 0; other plans must have a tier greater than 0

name.taken: This name is already in use

period.not_allowed: The period does not match the plan type

period_days.not_allowed: Only one-time plans can have a validity in days

currency.not_allowed: The currency must be the site currency

plans.conflict: Another admin changed this plan. Reload before editing.
plans.conflict_reloaded: Another admin changed this plan. The page has been reloaded; check and try again.
plans.update_invalid_state: This change is not allowed now: paid plans need a price on sale before going on sale; plans with entitlements cannot return to draft; plans with prices or entitlements cannot change type.
plans.delete_description: Only plans that were never priced and have no entitlements can be deleted. This cannot be undone.
plans.delete_invalid_state: This plan has prices or entitlements and cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
plans.groups_intro: Users on this plan can use the hosts in these groups. Removing a group takes effect immediately and is a sensitive action.
plans.groups_no_permission: You cannot view location groups; only their IDs are shown.
plans.group_tier_warning: Plan tier {{tier}} is below this group's minimum tier {{min}}; users will not get its hosts.
plans.remove_group_for: Remove location group {{name}} from the plan
plans.remove_group_effect: Users on this plan lose access to this group immediately.

prices.title: Prices
prices.intro: Once created, a price's amount, currency and period cannot change; it can only be discontinued. To change a price, create a new one.
prices.create_description: If the same period already has a price on sale, that price is discontinued at the same time. Prices cannot be edited after creation.
prices.amount_format: Invalid amount or too many decimal places
prices.amount_positive: The amount must be greater than 0
prices.no_currency: The site currency is unknown: you need permission to view settings, or an admin with that permission must create the first price.
prices.discontinue_description: {{period}} {{amount}} cannot be put back on sale once discontinued; create a new price instead.
prices.last_on_sale: This is the last price on sale for a plan that is on sale. Hide or archive the plan first.

groups.title: Location groups
groups.intro: Location groups bundle hosts; plans use them to decide which hosts users can reach. Member management arrives with host management.
groups.name: Name
groups.min_tier_hint: Plans below this tier do not receive this group's hosts. Leave empty for no minimum.
groups.form_description: Name and description are only shown in the console.
groups.conflict: Another admin changed this location group. Reload before editing.
groups.delete_in_use_one: This group is used by {{count}} plan; remove it from that plan before deleting.
groups.delete_in_use_other: This group is used by {{count}} plans; remove it from those plans before deleting.
groups.delete_invalid_state: This location group is still used by plans. Remove it from those plans first.
